102: def load_version(db: sqlite3.Connection, version_id: int) -> dict:
103:     row = db.execute("""
104:         SELECT f.function_key,f.language,f.domain,f.function_name,f.signature,
105:                f.specification,f.contract_sha256,
106:                v.version_id,v.parent_version_id,v.task_id,v.source_kind,
107:                v.source_sha256,v.code,v.code_sha256,v.tests_sha256,
108:                v.gate_name,v.gate_status,v.gate_output,v.gate_receipt_sha256,
109:                v.admitted_utc
110:         FROM function_versions v
111:         JOIN functions f USING(function_key)
112:         WHERE v.version_id=?
113:     """, (version_id,)).fetchone()

123:         raise ValueError(f"FUNCTION_SPEC_HASH_MISMATCH:{version_id}")

125:         version["language"], version["domain"], version["specification"])

132:         "function_key": version["function_key"],

146: def validate_edge(db: sqlite3.Connection, raw: sqlite3.Row,
147:                   versions: dict[int, dict]) -> dict:
148:     stored = json.loads(raw["evidence_json"])

153:         raise ValueError("RELAY_SCHEMA_UNSUPPORTED")

155:         raise ValueError("RELAY_RECEIPT_COLUMN_MISMATCH")
156:     receipt_payload = dict(stored)
157:     claimed_receipt = receipt_payload.pop("receipt_sha256")
158:     if canonical_hash(receipt_payload) != claimed_receipt:
159:         raise ValueError("RELAY_RECEIPT_HASH_MISMATCH")
160:     key_payload = dict(receipt_payload)
161:     claimed_key = key_payload.pop("relay_key", None)
162:     if claimed_key != raw["relay_key"] or canonical_hash(key_payload) != claimed_key:
163:         raise ValueError("RELAY_KEY_HASH_MISMATCH")
164:     provider_id = int(raw["provider_version_id"])
165:     consumer_id = int(raw["consumer_version_id"])
166:     provider = versions.setdefault(provider_id, load_version(db, provider_id))
167:     consumer = versions.setdefault(consumer_id, load_version(db, consumer_id))
168:     columns = {
169:         "provider_version_id": provider_id,
170:         "consumer_version_id": consumer_id,
171:         "provider_function_name": provider["function_name"],
172:         "consumer_function_name": consumer["function_name"],
173:         "direction": "PROVIDER_RETURN_TO_CALLER_TYPED_USE",
174:         "provider_output_type": raw["provider_output_type"],
175:         "consumer_input_type": raw["consumer_input_type"],
176:     }
177:     for key, value in columns.items():
178:         if stored.get(key) != value:
179:             raise ValueError(f"RELAY_COLUMN_EVIDENCE_MISMATCH:{key}")
180:     if callsite != stored.get("callsite"):
181:         raise ValueError("RELAY_CALLSITE_COLUMN_MISMATCH")
182:     if raw["provider_output_type"] != raw["consumer_input_type"]:
183:         raise ValueError("RELAY_TYPE_EDGE_MISMATCH")
184:     regenerated = relay_builder.typed_calls(
185:         provider, consumer, provider["function_code"], consumer["function_code"],
186:         provider["function_ast"], consumer["function_ast"])
187:     exact = [item for item in regenerated if item["relay_key"] == raw["relay_key"]]
188:     if len(exact) != 1 or canonical_hash(exact[0]) != canonical_hash(stored):
189:         raise ValueError("RELAY_SOURCE_OR_TYPE_EVIDENCE_MISMATCH")
190:     return {"row": dict(raw), "evidence": stored,
191:             "provider": provider, "consumer": consumer}

194: def edges_for_consumer(db: sqlite3.Connection, version_id: int,
195:                        versions: dict[int, dict]) -> list[dict]:
196:     rows = db.execute(f"""
197:         SELECT relay_key,provider_version_id,consumer_version_id,

199:                provider_output_type,consumer_input_type,callsite_json,
200:                evidence_json,receipt_sha256,created_utc
201:         FROM {TABLE}
202:         WHERE consumer_version_id=?
203:         ORDER BY provider_function_name,callsite_json,relay_key
204:     """, (version_id,)).fetchall()
205:     validated = [validate_edge(db, row, versions) for row in rows]
206:     providers_by_name: dict[str, int] = {}
207:     for edge in validated:
208:         name = edge["provider"]["function_name"]
209:         provider_id = edge["provider"]["version_id"]
210:         previous = providers_by_name.setdefault(name, provider_id)
211:         if previous != provider_id:
212:             raise ValueError(f"AMBIGUOUS_PROVIDER_VERSION:{name}")

214:         node.func.id for node in ast.walk(versions[version_id]["function_ast"])
215:         if isinstance(node, ast.Call) and isinstance(node.func, ast.Name)
216:     }
217:     candidate_names = {row[0] for row in db.execute("""
218:         SELECT DISTINCT f.function_name
219:         FROM function_versions v JOIN functions f USING(function_key)
220:         WHERE f.language='python' AND v.gate_status='ALLOW'
221:     """)}

224:     if unlinked_candidates:
225:         raise ValueError("MISSING_TYPED_RELAY:" + ",".join(unlinked_candidates))
226:     if represented - call_names:
227:         raise ValueError("RELAY_PROVIDER_NOT_CALLED:" + ",".join(sorted(represented - call_names)))
228:     return validated
